correctness.rationale: Every cubic through the 15 rational points is an alternating Frobenius cubic; smoothness of a (3,4) complete intersection forces its 4x4 alternating matrix full rank, hence 28 possible cubics and Sp4(F2) stabilizer of order720 for a fixed one. Quartic vanishing sections modulo G times linear forms form F2^16. Independently built 35-monomial evaluation kernel, dimension20, quotient dimension16, and traversed all 65536 classes via 15 symplectic transvections: 128 orbits, 288 classes smooth at all rational points in exactly two size-144 orbits, reps 13387 and 13394. Exact four-chart Groebner ideals in characteristic2 show 13394 geometrically smooth and 13387 singular; the packaged degree-five singular point further witnesses exclusion. Thus 28*144=4032 smooth embedded ideals in one orbit; stabilizer order720/144=5 cyclic. Independent symbolic reduction verified G and F vanish at all 15 rational points, A of order5 preserves G and F modulo G. Its irreducible degree4 characteristic polynomial Φ5 gives four fixed eigenlines; homogeneous eigenvalue scaling forces their incidence with C. Tame RH with genus19 and four totally ramified points gives quotient genus3. Exhaustive finite computations cover the precisely finite domain; not all fields or all types.
